alerts.title: Significant weight gain with emerging metabolic dysregulation on DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines state weight gain should be discussed when starting or switching ART, and proactive diet and exercise advice given to all patients starting or switching ART. Since switching to TLD 18 months ago, weight rose from 65 kg to 82 kg (BMI 25.6 to 32.4), waist is 96 cm, and acanthosis nigricans is present. Fasting glucose has risen from 92 to 118 mg/dL and HbA1c is 6.1%, with dyslipidaemia (LDL 148, HDL 38, TG 212) and BP 138/88. Dolutegravir is associated with weight gain, and family history of T2DM is significant, so DTG is a possible contributor but not the sole cause; lifestyle, family history and the natural course of weight change are also relevant. No clinician plan is documented for these findings.

evidence.recommended_action: Provide diet and exercise counselling now, repeat fasting glucose and lipids, screen for diabetes and hypertension management, and review the regimen with the treating clinician in light of metabolic deterioration and DTG-associated weight gain.
